blocks.text: To configure your organization's profile for Private Access (ZPA):

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Private Access Tenant.

Logo: Click Upload File to upload your organization's logo. You can upload any valid image file type that is 300x150 pixels or smaller. Your organization's logo is shown in the user portal and Privileged Remote Access (PRA) Portal. To learn more, see About User Portals and Accessing a Privileged Remote Access Portal.
Name: Enter the name of your organization. The name cannot contain special characters, with the exception of periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores ( _ ).
ZPA tenant ID: The ID for your organization’s Private Access tenant. This field cannot be edited.

Favicon: Click Upload File to upload your organization's favicon. You can upload an image with a valid image file type that is 32x32 pixels or smaller. After the favicon is successfully uploaded, it appears on the page. The favicon appears as the icon on a user portal browser tab, the PRA Portal browser tab, and privileged console browser tabs.
